about: An ultra-realistic surfing simulation with stunning graphics and complex physics.

Physics-driven surfing and trick mechanics allow you to experience a completely different ride every time. Use your bodyweight to master sharp turns and heavy aerials. See the water rushing over you when entering the barrel. You can choose from three different highly adjustable camera modes to make sure you don't miss the action and beauty. Surf world-class spots like Pipeline (Hawaii), Teahupoo (Tahiti), or Kirra (Australia) and choose the weather and wave conditions! Make your own surfboard designs and customize your surfer to master challenges and competitions with your surfer avatar! Or you can also choose the free surf mode and explore the waves and landscapes to find your favorite surf break.
Enhanced game play on PS4 Pro console
